# ClientExplain AI

> Legal process project workspace. Foundation release.

Available: create, view, edit and delete legal process projects.
Planned: document processing, source-backed analysis, generated illustrations, editable workflows, lawyer approval, version history, PDF and PNG exports.

All AI-generated legal explanations require professional review and are not verified legal advice. Use non-confidential test information in this evaluation release.

Private workspaces and API routes must not be indexed.
